lastCompletedStory.title: Resetar cap de respawn por progresso no wrapper do cam run

nextStoryContext: US-003 added jq-based reason read to buildOrchestratorPaneCommand in src/commands/run.ts. The bash wrapper now reads `.reason // empty` from the handoff file BEFORE renaming it to .consumed.json. When reason == 'cycle-close' it resets n=0; otherwise increments n. US-004 (next story) is 'Emitir reason: cycle-close no handoff do orquestrador' -- it likely touches the orchestrator agent prompt or the handoff-writing path (src/orchestrator/handoff.ts / .claude/agents/subagent-orchestrator.md) to ensure cycle-close is emitted as the reason when the orchestrator completes a normal cycle.

officialDocsValidated.summary: jq '.reason // empty' confirmed: absent key returns null, // empty suppresses null output (bash $() gives empty string), -r extracts raw string without quotes. Implementation matches docs.
